scope: Manufacturer-described equipment to investigate. These products are not in the declared team, are not tested here and cannot be assigned by this planner. The list is not a ranking or purchasing recommendation.

options.name: Ozmo
options.summary: The manufacturer describes robotic exterior-window cleaning using a building maintenance platform.
checks: Compatible building access platform and installation
Facade geometry, glazing and cleaning method
Exclusion area, trained staff and a site trial
options.sourceTitle: Skyline Robotics: Ozmo and existing maintenance units

options.name: Kite facade-cleaning robot
options.summary: The manufacturer describes a rotating brush moved across a facade by four cables and winches.
checks: Brush access to frames, recesses and facade materials
Weather limits, public protection and cleaning-quality trial

options.name: Sherpa cleaning drone
options.summary: The manufacturer describes exterior washing with ground-fed water or solution. A pilot controls the drone and a ground crew supports it.
checks: Trained pilot, ground crew and local flight permissions
Weather, airspace, hoses and keeping the public clear
Surface/product compatibility, runoff and a test panel; spraying may not replace scrubbing

options.name: KIRA B 50
options.summary: The manufacturer describes robotic scrubbing and drying for medium to large hard-floor areas.
checks: Floor material, slope, load and water tolerance
Route clearance, steps, low obstacles and people
Staff instruction, servicing and a site cleaning trial

options.name: KIRA CV 50
options.summary: The manufacturer lists robotic vacuum cleaning for medium-sized carpeted and hard-floor areas.
checks: Dry vacuuming matches the requested cleaning outcome
Floor and route suitability, obstacles and people
Operator instruction, docking and a site cleaning trial

options.name: WINBOT W2 PRO OMNI
options.summary: This consumer-facing product page describes a portable window-cleaning robot. It does not establish suitability or permitted commercial use for this job.
checks: Exact pane dimensions, glass type and permitted use in its manual
Safe placement/retrieval, fall protection and supervision
Cleaning outcome, commercial-use terms and a site trial
